thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate from cross-region routing layer (route-controller) — affected region pairs: us-west-2 <-> eu-west-1 — svc: inference-proxy — alert_id: CRR-4521

Olivia (oncall): seeing it, paging in. Currently ~8% 5xx on cross-region requests and 30-100ms extra tail latency for some customers.

Raj (neteng): looking at route-controller logs, I see a policy evaluation error for the new latency-steering rule deployed 03:12 UTC. Policy eval falling back to default route but with wrong "preferred_region" field set to "us-west-2" for eu customers.

Sofia (prod-sre): can you paste the failed eval snippet?

Raj (neteng): here's the snippet from the controller:
```
level=error msg="policy_eval_failed" id=route-131 region_request=eu-west-1 prefer_region=us-west-2 err="policy mismatch: matcher latency_bucket undefined"
```

Tim (support): customer-reports: two enterprise tenants in EU reporting 5xx and increased latency since 03:15. Tickets #2345, #2346. They are showing requests routed to us-west-2.

Olivia (oncall): impact: partial degraded routing for ~0.6% of total traffic, but concentrated on a handful of EU customers pinned by session keys. Escalating to P1? Thoughts?

Sofia (prod-sre): P1 for cross-region misroutes that cause customer-visible errors. Setting incident priority P1. Creating incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/CRR-4521

incident-bot: Incident CRR-4521 created, incident commander: Olivia (oncall) — runbook: cross-region-routing-misroute-v1

Raj (neteng): mitigation plan: temporarily disable the new latency-steering policy and roll back to stable policy v2. Also remove the erroneous preferred_region override in the policy engine. I can push rollback in 2 mins.

Olivia (oncall): go for rollback. Post the exact kubectl command you will run and we can watch.

Raj (neteng): running:
```bash
kubectl -n routing patch configmap route-policies --type=json -p='[ { "op": "replace", "path": "/data/latency-steering", "value": "v2" } ]'
```
Rolling now.

DataDogBot: metric update: cross-region-5xx-rate dropped from 8% -> 1.2% within 40s of rollback.

Tim (support): reported customers seeing errors clear around 03:17 UTC — support on a quick response to confirm.

Sofia (prod-sre): good, but we still have stuck sessions pinned to the wrong region for some users due to cached route pins in the proxy. Next step: invalidate pin cache for affected proxies (region-proxy-eu-*) and force reconnects.

Raj (neteng): invalidating KV:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/kv/invalidate" -d '{"prefix":"route_pin:eu-"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Done. I see reconnect churn but no new 5xx.

Olivia (oncall): can you run a targeted synthetic check for the two affected tenants?

Tim (support): running curls from eu probe: `curl -i -H "x-tenant: acme-eu" https://api.redwood.ai/generate`

Tim (support): response now 200 and region header shows `x-serving-region: eu-west-1` — looks good.

Sofia (prod-sre): rollout notes: revert diff in git: `route-policies` commit rc345 -> rc344, add unit test for matcher presence. We need an immediate patch to prevent policy engine from accepting undefined matchers.

Olivia (oncall): customer comms: Tim, draft short note: incident resolved for ACME EU and BetaCorp, root cause is bad latency-steering policy deploy that set an incorrect preferred_region when a matcher was undefined. Next: we will run a full reconciliation and add guardrails.

Tim (support): draft to customers: "We experienced a routing configuration issue that temporarily sent some EU traffic to a US region, causing errors and latency. We've rolled back the config and invalidated caches; traffic is now routing correctly. We're running further checks and will follow up with a post-incident report." :white_check_mark:

Sofia (prod-sre): postmortem action items: 1) add matcher presence validation in policy compiler (assigned Raj), 2) add automated canary for policy changes to catch preferred_region anomalies (assigned Olivia), 3) add alert rule for region-mismatch for tenant requests (assigned Sofia).

Raj (neteng): filing PR for validation now: https://git.internal/r/route-policy/PR-567 — will include schema change.

Olivia (oncall): closing incident channel in 30m unless we see regression. Great job triaging. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident CRR-4521 status -> mitigated (actions taken: rollback policy, invalidate route pins).

Sofia (prod-sre): one more note: need to coordinate with CDN partner — some edge caches also held old region hints; I'll open ops ticket with them.

Tim (support): customers ACME and BetaCorp confirmed recovery. I'll follow up with support tickets closed and attach timeline.

Olivia (oncall): last check at 03:55 UTC shows stable. Marking last_message_ts 1789457330.
